mike.h: Noticing a short 502/504 blip from the gateway ~09:10 UTC. overall rate small but spike visible in infra dashboard. Anyone know the quick set of links/queries to triage (logs, traces, per-route metrics)?

jordan: Start with Grafana -> 'gateway/errors' panel and group by `route`. Link: https://grafana.internal/redwood/d/6x4g/gateway-errors?orgId=1&from=now-1h&to=now. Check `sum(rate(envoy_cluster_upstream_rq_5xx[5m])) by (route)` and `envoy_downstream_rq_response_code`.

sophia: For logs use Loki: https://loki.internal/redwood/logs. Quick query (nginx gateway):
```
{job="gateway"} |~ "502|504" | json | line_format "{route} {upstream_addr} {request_id}"
```
That will give you sample `request_id` values for trace lookups.

ops-bot: Runbook: https://wiki.redwood/runbooks/gateway-5xx-triage (steps + escalation). :book:

mike.h: Perfect — if we want traces, what's the Tempo link pattern? I can paste a request_id.

jordan: Tempo: https://tempo.internal/trace/<TRACE_ID> . Use the `request_id` from logs to find matching `trace_id` in our log indexing. Example quick grep pattern in Loki:
```
{job="gateway"} |= "request_id=\"" | unwrap request_id | line_format "{trace_id} {request_id}"
```
Or use the trace-search dashboard: https://grafana.internal/redwood/d/trace-search/tempo-search.

sophia: From the metric side, check request latency vs upstream healthy hosts: `envoy_cluster_upstream_rq_time_bucket` and `envoy_cluster_upstream_rq_total{code="5xx"}`. If latency spiked at same time, likely backend overload. If latency stable and sudden 502s, maybe upstream connection resets or proxy timeout config.

mike.h: I pulled a sample request_id: `req-7b2a9c`. Found logs showing upstream reset + a trace id `11a2b3c4d5e6f7a8`. Link: https://tempo.internal/trace/11a2b3c4d5e6f7a8 — looks like a long tail on an internal backend RPC.

sophia: Thanks — create a quick ticket and tag the owning service (platform-backend). For alerts, we should consider debouncing the global 5xx alert: right now it fires on 1m windows. For gateway noise from retries, change to a 5m sliding window with a 3% threshold and add `group_by(route)` so single-route flaps don't wake paging. Also add `for: 2m` in pager rules.

jordan: Agreed. Proposed alert rule (promql):
```
(sum(rate(envoy_cluster_upstream_rq_5xx[5m])) by (route) / sum(rate(envoy_cluster_upstream_rq_total[5m])) by (route)) > 0.03
```
And then define severity = page if route in critical_routes else ticket.

mike.h: I'll open the ticket and include trace + links + suggested alert tweak. Also adding a note: where's the dashboard that shows upstream host counts/health?

sophia: Grafana -> gateway -> upstream-health panel (or this direct link): https://grafana.internal/redwood/d/7h9k/upstream-health. Look for `envoy_cluster_upstream_healthy_hosts` and `envoy_cluster_upstream_total_hosts`. If healthy hosts drop at spike time, that's your answer.

ops-bot: Ticket template: https://issues.redwood/template/gateway-5xx (auto-adds required fields).

mike.h: Thanks all — creating ticket now and will post ID here once done. :thumbsup:

sophia: If you want, I can PR the alert tweak to a branch after ticket is up.
mike.h: Please do that, appreciate it.
